title: Kitsuno Handshake v0.2 — L2 Disclosure (seeker → vacancy)
description: Machine-to-machine disclosure after the vacancy signaled interest. Mirrors the application form / recruiter pre-screen stage. Seeker agent builds this from the principal's PRS, including answers to the vacancy's l2_structured_questions (deterministic from PRS where possible, LLM-generated for free_form_questions). The vacancy poster reviews; if they want to proceed to humans, they fire L3 release.

disclosure_tier.description: Always L2 for this message type. Indicates the highest tier of information present.

structured_answers.description: Answers to the vacancy's l2_structured_questions, one per question_id. Answer type matches the question's answer_type.

answer.description: Type depends on the question's answer_type (yes_no=bool, integer=int, text=str, enum=str, money=Money, date=ISO date).

source.description: Provenance of the answer. Deterministic answers are pulled from explicit PRS fields; llm_inferred is generated by LLM from PRS context (lower confidence).

free_form_answers.description: Answers to the vacancy's l2_free_form_questions, one per question text. LLM-generated from PRS.

experience_summary.description: Top relevant roles from PRS — at L2 we disclose role + company + duration + summary, but NOT the full position descriptions or evidence (those wait for L3).

skills.description: Skills from PRS that match this vacancy's required_skills + nice_to_have_skills.

verification.description: Attestation of the seeker principal, re-asserted on each L2 disclosure for freshness.
